name: Wispr Flow
whatItDoes: Dictate a messy idea into text.
whatItEnables: Get an unpolished idea onto the page before organizing it.
starterTask: Dictate a 90-second idea. Circle three missing decisions before asking AI to structure it.
obsolescenceReason: Interfaces change; the underlying workflow and verification skill transfer.
manualVsDelegate: Keep corrections, names and intended meaning manual; delegate transcription.

name: Granola
whatItEnables: Recover decisions and open questions from consented conversations.
starterTask: Use a fictional meeting transcript to produce decisions, actions and questions; compare it with your own notes.
obsolescenceReason: Interfaces change; the underlying workflow and verification skill transfer.
manualVsDelegate: Keep recording consent and confirmation of commitments manual.

name: Claude · Projects & Skills
whatItDoes: Draft and review documents with reusable instructions.
whatItEnables: Reuse a clear brief, reference material and review instructions across related drafts.
starterTask: Draft one PRD section with goals, constraints and acceptance criteria; then challenge one assumption.
obsolescenceReason: Interfaces change; the underlying workflow and verification skill transfer.
manualVsDelegate: Keep risk acceptance and factual verification manual; delegate structure and alternatives.

name: ChatGPT · custom GPTs
whatItDoes: Explore a task through structured conversation.
whatItEnables: Iterate on a draft or rehearse a reviewer’s questions with reusable instructions.
starterTask: Compare a vague request with a role, context, constraints and output format; mark the useful differences.
obsolescenceReason: Interfaces change; the underlying workflow and verification skill transfer.
manualVsDelegate: Keep original authorship and final decisions manual; delegate brainstorming and critique.

name: Perplexity
whatItDoes: Find starting points for sourced research.
whatItEnables: Find candidate sources for a research question that you can independently verify.
starterTask: Build a three-claim evidence ledger. Open every cited source and check that it supports the claim.
obsolescenceReason: Research interfaces change; tracing claims to original evidence remains useful.
manualVsDelegate: Keep source inspection manual. A citation is a lead, not proof.

name: NotebookLM / Google Notebook
whatItDoes: Explore material from a bounded source collection.
whatItEnables: Ask focused questions about reference material you have selected.
starterTask: Add approved reference material and ask for competing interpretations; trace each point to the original.
obsolescenceReason: Research interfaces change; tracing claims to original evidence remains useful.
manualVsDelegate: Keep document permissions and interpretation manual; delegate organization.

name: Gamma
whatItDoes: Structure a presentation from an outline.
whatItEnables: Turn a reviewed outline into a presentation starting point.
starterTask: Convert a five-bullet project outline into a short deck; replace any unsupported claims.
obsolescenceReason: Interfaces and automation features evolve quickly; keep the brief, critique and testing skills portable.
manualVsDelegate: Keep narrative, brand review and factual accuracy manual.

name: Figma
whatItDoes: Develop and review interface design directions.
whatItEnables: Explore and refine an interface or visual direction collaboratively.
starterTask: Sketch a three-screen task flow and critique hierarchy, focus order and missing states.
obsolescenceReason: Interfaces and automation features evolve quickly; keep the brief, critique and testing skills portable.
manualVsDelegate: Keep visual craft and accessibility judgment manual.

name: Cursor
whatItDoes: Explore code with an AI-assisted editor.
whatItEnables: Develop a small automation with coding assistance in an editor.
starterTask: Ask for a CSV validation script using synthetic rows; inspect it and test a failing example.
obsolescenceReason: Interfaces and automation features evolve quickly; keep the brief, critique and testing skills portable.
manualVsDelegate: Keep code review, permissions and release decisions manual.

name: Codex
whatItDoes: Delegate bounded coding tasks and review changes.
whatItEnables: Build or modify software from a concrete task and verification criteria.
starterTask: Specify a small local data-cleaning task; inspect the changes and run tests on a synthetic sample.
obsolescenceReason: Interfaces and automation features evolve quickly; keep the brief, critique and testing skills portable.
manualVsDelegate: Keep requirements, code review and deployment approval manual.

name: Zoom · AI meeting notes
whatItEnables: Create a first-pass record of a consented meeting for review.
starterTask: Compare a meeting summary against your notes; correct decisions and confirm action owners.
obsolescenceReason: Interfaces change; the underlying workflow and verification skill transfer.
manualVsDelegate: Keep participant consent and commitment confirmation manual.

name: Google Sheets
whatItEnables: Inspect tabular data and verify formulas in a familiar grid.
starterTask: Clean a copied sample table, record changes and reconcile totals before interpreting a chart.
obsolescenceReason: Interfaces change; the underlying workflow and verification skill transfer.
manualVsDelegate: Keep definitions and sanity checks manual; delegate formula suggestions.

name: Google Docs
whatItDoes: Collaborate on a document and review revisions.

starterTask: Draft an outline, annotate missing evidence and revise one paragraph in your own voice.
obsolescenceReason: Interfaces change; the underlying workflow and verification skill transfer.
manualVsDelegate: Keep authorship and stakeholder sign-off manual.

name: Asana

obsolescenceReason: Interfaces change; the underlying workflow and verification skill transfer.

name: Canva
